details.label: INCORRECT
details.reasoning: The gold target identifies both Italy and China as the countries tied for hosting the most Olympic Games. The prediction correctly names China but omits Italy, so it does not give the complete answer.
details.groundedness_reasoning:
1. Citation [1] identifies Italy’s 2006 and 2026 Olympic Games and China’s 2008 and 2022 Games.
2. Those dates support deriving the gold target’s two countries when the 20-year period includes the 2026 Games.
3. The citation lists the host years rather than explicitly stating that Italy and China tie for the most in the specified period; the derivation relies on comparing the listed dates.
